Charger: RISET=1.78k -> 500mA nominal. RILIM=1.62k -> about 0.994A nominal (1610 / R).
TS uses actual pack 10k NTC. Modem on BAT complicates termination; review power path before release.
Caps below are electrical values only: final MPN, effective capacitance, package and placement remain open.
Battery pack: protected 1S, 650-800mAh, >=2.5A pulse rating; connector current and charging thermal budget TBD.
Default safety timer retained; NTC is not bypassed. No cell pack protection circuit assumed to be on this board.
PWR_FLAG marks GND and VBUS_5V as supplied from outside this schematic (battery and pogo connector). They are not generated by any symbol pin.
